Epiphyllum , / ˌ ɛ p ɪ ˈ f ɪ l əm / ; [ 3 ] from Ancient Greek ἐπι- ( epi- ), meaning "upon", and φύλλον ( phúllon ), meaning "leaf", is a genus of epiphytic plants in the cactus family (Cactaceae), native to Central America and South America. Common names for these species include climbing cacti , orchid cacti and leaf cacti , though the latter also refers to the genus Pereskia .
